newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Shun Tak staff cut saves HK$13 mln yearly.
newsitem.headline: Shun Tak staff cut saves HK$13 mln yearly.

text.p: Shun Tak Holdings Ltd said on Wednesday its coming redundancy move would save it an annual HK$13 million in salary payment.
The company will dismiss 50 to 60 employees after the recent withdrawal of two jetfoils from its Hong Kong-Macau route due to lower-than-expected market demand.

Director Pansy Ho told reporters on Wednesday the redundancy plan did not represent a long-term staff-cutting strategy, and the company did not intend to dismiss more employees thereafter. At present, 16 jetfoil and two foilcats serve Shun Tak's Hong Kong-Macau routes.
The company was considering how to use the two laid-off vessels and they could be put on its routes outside Hong Kong and Macau, Ho said.
